question_or_task: Lunch and canteen: What is today's menu? What are the prices?
source_path: Canteen website → Canteen Manager / Lunch Adapter
observed_response_examples: Supplied dishes and prices directly; in another case said no menu was available.

question_or_task: Events and activities: What is coming up? Tell me about this event.
source_path: CRM / event-management system; some BookStack documents
observed_response_examples: Listed events, dates and descriptions. In another case supplied an outdated list, acknowledged it, and asked the user for a current list.

question_or_task: Registration, tickets and attendance: How do I register? Where is my QR code?
observed_response_examples: Supplied registration links and sent confirmation/ticket messages; some exchanges ended in repeated clarification or a referral.

question_or_task: Opening Week: What is my schedule? What should I wear?
observed_response_examples: Gave dress codes and some schedule details. Some personal schedules or exact times were missing, so users were sent to their own schedule.

question_or_task: Classes, courses and exams: What is my timetable? When are my exams?
source_path: Programme/exam knowledge documents; Canvas, Online Campus and TimeEdit links
observed_response_examples: Sometimes supplied class-day information. Other requests received timetable links or portal referrals instead of the requested dates or full schedule.
included_categories: Timetables / classes / courses; Exams / grades / assignments

question_or_task: Student ID, administration, IT and staff contacts: How do I replace my ID? Where can I get help?
source_path: BookStack administrative, IT and staff-contact documents
observed_response_examples: Gave replacement steps, support hours and contacts. Account-access problems were referred to IT; some requested contact details were unavailable.
included_categories: Documents / student ID / administration; IT / Canvas / accounts; Study advisors / staff contacts

question_or_task: Notifications and opt-outs: Change my preferences or stop sending menus.
observed_response_examples: Acknowledged some requests to stop menu messages. Other stop requests had no eligible reply in the segment; saved preference changes were not verified.
included_categories: Notification preferences / opt-out; Unsubscribe / stop notifications
